[ 02 / THE POSSIBILITIES ]FROM “WHAT IF?” TO “THAT’S IT.”

What can
we make
better?

A new idea, an existing product, or a journey that needs untangling. There’s a thoughtful place to start.

THOUGHTFUL BY DESIGN

Help visitors understand your offering, explore with confidence, and take the next step. An experience with a clear story and a visual identity of its own.

Website UX/UILanding pagesResponsive design

Turn everyday tasks into intuitive journeys. Clear navigation, thoughtful interfaces and purposeful interactions, designed for the way people use their phones.

User flowsMobile UIInteractive prototypes

Bring structure to complex products. Help people find what matters, understand what is happening and act on it without losing their place.

Product workflowsDashboard UIInformation architecture

Give an existing experience a fresh perspective and a stronger foundation. Find the friction, improve the important journeys and build consistency into the details.

UX auditsProduct redesignsComponent libraries

[ 03 / THE APPROACH ]GOOD DESIGN DOESN’T HAPPEN BY ACCIDENT.

A clear
process.
Room for
discovery.

A shared direction at every stage, with space to ask questions, explore possibilities and give useful feedback.

START WITH THE RIGHT QUESTIONS01

Understand.

Get to know your business, your users, and the problem worth solving. Look for the need behind the initial request.

Business goalsUser needsResearch
MAKE THE COMPLEX FEEL CLEAR02

Structure.

Turn insights into priorities, user journeys and wireframes. Find a clear path before deciding how every screen should look.

User flowsWireframesInformation architecture
GIVE THE IDEA ITS CHARACTER03

Create.

Develop a visual direction and shape the interface around it. Consider the typography, spacing and interactions as one experience.

Visual directionUI designComponents
TRY. LEARN. MAKE IT BETTER.04

Refine.

Explore the prototype, gather feedback and improve the important details. Make the experience tangible before it moves into development.

PrototypesUsability feedbackIteration
READY FOR THE NEXT CHAPTER05

Deliver.

Prepare organised Figma files, reusable components and interaction notes, giving the people building the product a clear place to start.

Figma filesDesign systemsDeveloper handoff

Independent
in spirit.
Human
by design.

Mavocado is an independent UX/UI design studio led by Mahesh Shanbhag. A space for ambitious ideas, honest questions and useful digital experiences.

The M stands for Made for people. A reminder to look beyond the screen—to the person making a decision, completing a task or trying something for the first time.

Small enough for a direct conversation. Thoughtful enough to care about the details.

Let’s talk
Yes. An initial idea can be developed into user flows, wireframes and a prototype, making the experience easier to explore, discuss and refine.
Yes. The starting point is understanding what works, where people struggle and what the redesign needs to achieve. The scope can focus on a specific journey or a wider experience.
Deliverables depend on the agreed scope and may include research findings, user flows, wireframes, interface designs, interactive prototypes and reusable components in Figma.
After discussing the project’s scope, complexity and expected timeline, a proposal sets out the work, deliverables and project milestones.
The studio focuses on UX/UI design, with organised design files and guidance for developer handoff. Any implementation requirements should be discussed before the project begins.
